data.narrative:
Nu Quantum is a Series A quantum computing company founded by Carmen Palacios-Berraquero that has raised $60M to date. The quantum computing sector contains 11 comparable companies: 3 public (IONQ, RGTI, QBTS) and 8 private firms including Quantinuum, IonQ, D-Wave Quantum, Rigetti Computing, and Infleqtion.

A peer-median approach was not applicable due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within the quantum computing universe. Stage-progression analysis proved the only viable triangulation method. Using total capital raised ($60M) as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A-to-next-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $120M.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $102M to $138M, with a median point of $120M. The width of this range (15% below to 15% above median) reflects uncertainty inherent in deriving a single-method valuation. Key risks to this estimate include the absence of narrow-stage peer benchmarks in quantum computing—a sector with heterogeneous business models and development timelines—and the reliance on capital raised as a valuation proxy rather than revenue or performance metrics. Further refinement would require either identification of additional same-stage comparables or acquisition of financial performance data from existing peers.
